k2_support_bounds._rationale: Physical-k2 support guard, IDENTICAL box to titan_freegrav_noocean.json (scientific-reviewer a2d7f121). Fluid-limit secular Love ceiling k2<=3/2 => Re_k2 in [-0.1,1.5]; dissipation cannot exceed elastic response => |Im_k2| in [0,1.0]. Applied to the NOISELESS forward output before obs noise (imag_convention='abs' globally: guard sees |Im_k2|), counted as a support rejection so SBI training support == reference-MCMC effective support. Physics-anchored, NOT tuned to pass. In the JOINT posterior this box ADMITS the frozen no-ocean nodes (verified: frozen (249,1) gives Re_k2=0.113, |Im_k2|=0.069, both inside the box) so they enter the posterior in the likelihood-disfavored low-k2 tail rather than being support-rejected.

metadata.description: Titan free-gravity SBI campaign, NH3-ocean interior model, Phase B of the Titan free-gravity plan (plans/fluffy-snacking-fountain.md). This is a JOINT no-ocean + ocean posterior (Task #68, user decision 2026-07-30 re-affirmed 2026-08-02): the (Tb, w) plane is a tilted band whose cold/fresh corner is genuinely frozen (no ice-Ih->liquid transition anywhere in the Pfreeze window). Rather than rejecting those frozen nodes (which would implicitly condition the posterior on 'an ocean exists'), the 2D structure cache is built with build_tbw_grid_cache(..., retry_frozen_as_no_ocean=True): a node raising NoIceLiquidTransitionError is retried once as a REAL no-ocean interior (do_overrides NO_OCEAN_EXCEPT_INNER_ICES=True, comp='NH3' kept so the NH3-depressed liquidus still sets the HP-ice temperature profile) and stored tagged has_ocean=False. Both regimes therefore appear in the amortized posterior. Interior priors, derived rho_sil (mass conservation), rheology/thermal parameter space, gravity channel, and observable vector are IDENTICAL to titan_freegrav_noocean.json (reviewer action item 3: consistent dissipation across no-ocean and all ocean configs); the differences are (1) Tb_K widened to the full joint range [249,263] K, (2) log10_wOcean_ppt salinity axis added, (3) a 2D (Tb x w) NH3 structure cache replaces the 1D no-ocean cache, (4) phase_stability.enforce is DROPPED (see phase_stability_dropped_reason).
metadata.reference: Petricca et al. (2025), Nature 648:558 (gravity C20/C22, k2, MoI); interior parameterization from test52 (Yao 2014 spherical Ih convection, Kalousova HP convection, Arrhenius viscosity, Andrade rheology). NH3 ocean EOS via the Melinder-anchored Redlich-Kister activity model (commit 6c5ee2af, 2026-07-28).

salinity_axis_2026_08_02.ceiling_rationale: NH3 physical ceiling is 7 wt% = 70 ppt (mass fraction of solution; NOT per-kg-solvent molality). log10(70)=1.845098. This is the per-composition salinity range set for NH3 in the campaign spec (plans/fluffy-snacking-fountain.md 'Decisions locked with the user'). Prior is uniform in log10 w (Jeffreys).

metadata.phase_stability_dropped_reason: phase_stability.enforce is NOT set (contrast titan_freegrav_noocean.json which sets 'no_ocean_Ih'). The no_ocean_Ih guard REJECTS any sample where an ocean WOULD form; it is precisely what makes the no-ocean artifact no-ocean-only. There is no 'must-have-ocean' guard by default, so OMITTING enforce is exactly what admits BOTH the frozen no-ocean regime and the ocean regime into the joint posterior. density_inversion_guard (on rho_sil) and k2_support_bounds still apply uniformly to both regimes (physical training-set hygiene, reviewer MODERATE: do not drop the k2 guard wholesale or the extreme-k2 tail returns).
